# School timetable maker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/school-timetable/

Create a weekly school timetable with your own periods, subjects and breaks, then export a printable page or CSV.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Build a Monday-to-Friday schedule with six periods and a lunch break.

## Limits and checks

This is a manual schedule builder. It does not solve teacher availability or detect every real-world room conflict.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
